#nullable enable

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using T;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options => {
    options.SerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
    options.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
});

builder.Services.AddDbContext<TDbCtx>(options => options.UseInMemoryDatabase("T"));

var app = builder.Build();

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<TDbCtx>();
    await SeedAsync(db);
}

app.MapGet("/api/notes", async (TDbCtx db) => await db.Notes.ToListAsync());

app.MapGet("/api/notes/{id}", async (int id, TDbCtx db) => (await db.Notes.FindAsync(id) is T.Note note ? Results.Ok(note) : StatusProblem(404, "Not Found")));

app.MapPost("/api/notes", async (NoteDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var noteResult = T.Note.Create(dto.Body);
    if (!noteResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        return Problem(noteResult.Error!);
    }
    db.Notes.Add(noteResult.Value);
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    return Results.Ok(noteResult.Value);
});

app.MapPost("/api/notes/{id}/setbody", async (int id, SetBodyDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var entity = await db.Notes.FindAsync(id);
    if (entity == null)
    {
        return StatusProblem(404, "Not Found", "Note not found");
    }
    try
    {
        var result = entity.SetBody(dto.V);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Results.Ok("ok");
        }
        else
        {
            return Problem(result.Error!);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception)
    {
        return StatusProblem(500, "Internal Server Error");
    }
});

app.MapPost("/api/notes/{id}/setmemo", async (int id, SetMemoDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var entity = await db.Notes.FindAsync(id);
    if (entity == null)
    {
        return StatusProblem(404, "Not Found", "Note not found");
    }
    try
    {
        var result = entity.SetMemo(dto.V);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Results.Ok("ok");
        }
        else
        {
            return Problem(result.Error!);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception)
    {
        return StatusProblem(500, "Internal Server Error");
    }
});

static IResult Problem(Poly.Runtime.DomainFailure failure)
{
    var extensions = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
    if (failure.ElementPath != null)
    {
        extensions["elementPath"] = failure.ElementPath;
    }
    if (failure.Guard != null)
    {
        extensions["guard"] = failure.Guard;
    }
    return Results.Problem(failure.Message, null, Poly.Runtime.DomainFailureStatus.Http(failure.Kind), failure.Kind.ToString(), null, extensions);
}


static IResult StatusProblem(int status, string title, string? detail = null)
{
    return Results.Problem(detail, null, status, title);
}


static async System.Threading.Tasks.Task SeedAsync(TDbCtx db)
{
    if (db == null)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (await db.Notes.AnyAsync())
    {
        return;
    }
    var noteResult = T.Note.Create("Sample");
    if (noteResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        db.Add(noteResult.Value);
    }
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
}


app.Run();

{
    [Required]
    public string Body { get; init; } = default!;
}

internal record SetBodyDto
{
    [Required]
    public string V { get; init; } = default!;
}

internal record SetMemoDto
{
    public string V { get; init; } = default!;
